messages:
claire (People Ops): Hi team — building a tiny 'manager + IC paste kit' for self-reviews and quick OKR lines. Goal: copy/paste in <90s. Can you sanity-check and add any must-have micro-phrases?

omar (Eng Manager): Love the idea. Key asks: include one example for infra work and one for research. Also a short manager calibration sentence for skip-levels.

claire (People Ops): Draft below (super short). Reply with edits.

```
MANAGER + IC QUICK-REVIEW KIT (paste-ready)

OKR / goal naming (one-liner):
- format: team.goal.metric.quarter  e.g. platform.cache.hit_rate.q3

IC one-line self-review (3 parts):
- Outcome: "What shipped + metric or signal"  e.g. "Reduced recs p95 18% (420->344ms); canary rolled"
- Contribution: "My role / ownership"  e.g. "Led async batching, added e2e perf tests"
- Ask / risk: "One-line ask or risk note"  e.g. "Need 40 node-hours for canary; monitoring set"

Infra example (paste):
- Outcome: "Migrated cache to managed cluster; error rates down 25%"
- Contribution: "Ran migration plan, validated failover; coordinated infra hours"
- Ask: "Request [INF-REQ] 2 node-hours for final validation"

Research / docs example (paste):
- Outcome: "Published 4 model-failure notes; 2 teams adopted mitigations"
- Contribution: "Synthesized experiments; wrote playbook"
- Ask: "Request 8h partnership time with PM for rollout"

Manager micro-prompts (drop into 1:1):
- "If we only ship one thing this quarter, which one keeps the user impact?"
- "What's the smallest testable slice we can commit to this sprint?"
- "If this slows down, what should I de-schedule to keep momentum?"

Manager skip-level calibration sentence (one-line to paste):
- "Manager note: shifted scope to MVP for infra reasons; metric is expected to trail by ~2 weeks; approved HC-REQ for 1 SWE if runway needed."

Quick calibration tags (one-word, paste after review):
- MET / AT-RISK / SHIFTED

HC / ops tagging (so requests surface):
- Append to ask line: [HC-REQ] / [INF-REQ] / [DATA-REQ]

Privacy reminder (one-line):
- "If work touches customer data/PII, confirm retention & DSR steps with security before shipping."
```

jia (SWE): This is great. Tiny nit: for the self-review ask, suggest including an urgency marker like (low/med/high) so ops can triage.

talia (Recruiter): Add a one-line example for headcount asks in reviews: "Ask: hire 1 SWE to reduce on-call load [HC-REQ][priority:med]". That helps our pipeline.

omar (Eng Manager): For skip-levels: maybe include a 1-line impact summary: "Impact: +9% success queries" to make scanning faster. Otherwise LGTM.

claire (People Ops): Perfect — adding urgency and the HC example. Will publish to templates and pin in #people-ops. ETA: today. Any objections to the naming format?

omar (Eng Manager): No objections. Also suggest we promote the MET/AT-RISK/SHIFTED tags in manager training next week.

notif-bot: Quick-kit uploaded: https://redwood.internal/templates/quick-review-kit-v1 (uploaded by claire) :white_check_mark:

claire (People Ops): Thanks everyone! I'll drop a short GIF demo of how to paste these into reviews in the templates doc. :sparkles:
